text: Vale drops the rose-and-hygrometer plan entirely, giving up on slowing everyone down as the whole gang stampedes to the riverbank chasing Dusk's mystery. Flint calls the water-crisis debate "distraction theater," and even Reed abandons Vale to go stare at the shifted stones with the others. Everyone agrees something is buried under those rocks — bigger than roots, bigger than roses — and now the entire cast is huddled at the river waiting for the big reveal, while the actual water-vs-farms decision sits completely forgotten.
